title: Sprint 6 — Self-Contained Game Foundation

tasks.title: Client builds against the engine

review.notes: Engine boundary verified by hand: fs/process/document fail tsc in engine folders; importing react from src/session fails lint. npm audit 0.

deviations: Combatant imported from src/types/combat (not exported from src/types/index)
stateUpdaters.ts casts changed from NodeJS.ErrnoException to Error (type-only; engine tsconfig has no Node types)
unanticipated_decisions: eslint-disable for react-hooks/set-state-in-effect on TeamSelector's existing resync effect (rewriting it would change UI behavior)
tsconfig.node.json lib ES2023
Lint fixes in files the old setup never linted (unused helper removed, let→const)

tasks.title: Game session core

review.notes: Security review FAIL on first pass: getNpc('constructor') returned Object and setTeam accepted prototype keys (both inherited from the old routes). Fixed with own-property checks in the session layer; tests in src/session/operations/protoKeys.test.ts.

unanticipated_decisions: Validation messages worded in the old schema validator's style (code is always VALIDATION_ERROR)
getNpc refuses a non-string id with VALIDATION_ERROR
operations/outcome.ts helper module added

tasks.title: Narrative and dialogue in the session

review.notes: Builder check caught the prototype-key lookup in startDialogue; fixed. Security review FAIL: session returned shared mutable content objects (scenes, nodes, encounters) across sessions. Fixed by deep-cloning and freezing content per session (src/session/freeze.ts).

deviations: Dialogue node owner found by scanning content per call instead of a prebuilt index (same behavior; node ids must be unique across NPCs)
unanticipated_decisions: placeholders.json wraps trees in { _note, dialogues } so the placeholder label lives in the file
Starting a dialogue mid-conversation overwrites currentDialogueNode

tasks.title: Combat in the session

review.notes: Security review FAIL: unbounded energySegments (1e308 instant KO, negatives heal) and orders accepted for enemy combatants, both inherited from the old route. Escalated; designer chose to fix both (ADR-060).

deviations: Designer-approved rule change (ADR-060): declarations limited to the player's party; energySegments only on SPECIAL, integer 1..current energy
unanticipated_decisions: COMBAT_ALREADY_ACTIVE message: 'A combat encounter is already active'
Unknown encounter id reports ENCOUNTER_NOT_FOUND even during a fight (spec check order)

tasks.title: Port the server-based tests to the session

review.notes: Suites run and pass with real assertions, no skips. One-to-one describe mapping; dropped tests listed in each file header (HTTP-only or moved to T9). No session bugs found.

unanticipated_decisions: Shared tests/helpers/quickFight.ts builds lopsided encounter copies to reach victory/defeat through the session
e2e determinism scenario runs two sessions sequentially (originals used Promise.all over servers)

tasks.title: HUD runs on the in-client game

review.notes: Provider behavior matches the pre-change HTTP provider (refusal message to banner; success leaves the banner). No fetch or /api references remain under src/ui.

tasks.title: Client tests on the in-client game

review.notes: UI project runs 61 tests, all passing. No network mocks; fetch spy proves zero calls.

unanticipated_decisions: Refused team change tested at provider level only (the HUD disables the controls in combat/scenes, so the UI can't trigger a refusal)

tasks.title: Local save storage

review.notes: validateGameState confirmed a verbatim port. Security review FAIL: a crafted save made validateGameState throw, breaking list() for all slots. Fixed: parseSave never throws, 2,000,000-char cap, reasons capped at 10 x 200 chars. Re-review PASS.

unanticipated_decisions: parseSave also treats a bad kind/slot/savedAt/playerName as corrupted
Deleting a corrupted slot is allowed; deleting an empty slot gives SAVE_NOT_FOUND
list() fails whole on a backend STORAGE_ERROR
Async commit is decided against the snapshot the operation started from; load always wins

tasks.title: Save storage tests

review.notes: Suites run and pass; no fs/os/path imports; only the jsdom test touches localStorage and clears its own keys. Includes a prototype-pollution save test.

deviations: validateGameState port is 39 tests, not 74: the other tests in saveLoad.test.ts were disk-based and are replaced by saveStore.test.ts
unanticipated_decisions: saveStore.smoke.test.ts kept alongside saveStore.test.ts (overlapping cases; can be folded later)

tasks.title: Scene renderer

review.notes: Robustness fixes after review: .catch on the lazy Phaser import, and no restart of the scene already showing. Phaser builds as its own 1.37 MB chunk. Not run in a browser: the one-canvas check under StrictMode/Fast Refresh is reasoned, not observed.

unanticipated_decisions: createPhaserGame export name
Scenes added via game.scene.add with autoStart only for the initial scene

tasks.title: Stage behind the HUD

review.notes: Today's layout carried into the HUD layer unchanged; stage layer aria-hidden. Not checked in a browser: visual before/after and resize are reasoned from the CSS.

deviations: Designer decision 2026-10-24: the HUD layer scrolls when the window is shorter than the HUD, instead of clipping. The scrollbar is hidden because a pointer-events:none layer can't host a draggable one; wheel, touch and keyboard focus scroll it.
unanticipated_decisions: overscroll-behavior: contain on the HUD layer

tasks.title: Retire the server and consolidate to one command

review.notes: Greps for fastify, src/api, saveLoad, buildApp, inject(, 3000 and /api/ are clean outside docs/, dist/ and gitignored tooling. npm run verify: 59 files, 1328 tests. npm audit 0.

unanticipated_decisions: Fixed stale server mentions in key_facts.md beyond the listed sections
Renamed /api/... describe titles in tests/session.* to session wording

files_created: src/session/** (index, gameSession, sessionState, result, content, validation, freeze, encounters, operations/*, tests)
src/render/** (renderer, sceneKeys, phaserRenderer, phaserGame, scenes/index, scenes/StageScene, phaserRenderer.test)
escalated_issues: Combat orders: unbounded energySegments and orders for enemy units → designer chose to fix both (ADR-060)
Short windows clipped the HUD under the no-scroll layout → designer chose a HUD layer that scrolls when needed
known_limitations: validateGameState checks are shallow (combat array elements, NPC numeric ranges, extra keys); ported byte-for-byte per spec. Hand-edited saves can carry odd but well-typed data.
Engine updateTeamComposition still uses `id in state.npcs`; the session guards every in-game path.
Dialogue and combat ids have no length cap (parity with the old routes); dialogue node ids must be unique across NPCs.
Round history, last fight outcome and game state are returned unfrozen (immutable by convention); freeze helper doesn't handle cycles, Maps or Dates (none in current content).
.gitignore doesn't cover mode-specific env files such as .env.production (pre-existing; no env files exist).
Nothing was run in a real browser: one canvas under StrictMode/Fast Refresh, HUD pixel parity, resize behavior and HUD scrolling are for the verify phase.
